name: com.char-gen/chargen
title: CharGen
description: Remote MCP server for D&D: read and update your CharGen campaigns, generate NPCs and art.

tools.name: chargen_add_collection_item
tools.description: File an item into a folder. target_id is the thing being filed (a generation id by default; set item_type for CAMPAIGN_ENTITY, DOCUMENT, SESSION, IMAGE or VIDEO_PROJECT). When filing CAMPAIGN_ENTITY, DOCUMENT, SESSION or VIDEO_PROJECT into a codex folder that a campaign references, campaign_id is REQUIRED - the item lands in that campaign's overlay, not the codex itself. IMAGE items can only be filed into campaign workspace folders and Atlas places (folders with place=true), never other codex folders, and only your own pictures: another member's picture, public or not, is not_found. Filing the same target twice updates the existing row: an omitted note clears it, an omitted pinned value unpins it, and an omitted sort_order keeps the current position.

collection_id.description: Folder UUID

target_id.description: UUID of the item to file (generation, campaign entity, document, session, image or completed film)

campaign_id.description: Required when filing CAMPAIGN_ENTITY/DOCUMENT/SESSION/VIDEO_PROJECT into a codex folder the campaign references (routes into that campaign's overlay)

note.description: Optional note on the filed item

pinned.description: Pin the item to the top of the folder

sort_order.description: Optional sort position within the folder (lower sorts first)

tools.name: chargen_apply_find_replace
tools.description: Replace text in one owned session. First inspect chargen_preview_find_replace and obtain user approval; confirm must be true. Optional merge_id records the rename with chargen_merge_entities so undoing that merge also reverses the rename.

merge_id.description: Optional merge UUID from chargen_merge_entities - links this rename to the merge so undoing the merge also reverses it

tools.name: chargen_attach_image
tools.description: Attach one of the user's existing gallery images to a tracked world-graph entity in a campaign, so it shows on that entity. image_id comes from chargen_search_gallery or chargen_get_generation. Re-attaching the same image updates only its title and caption (omitting them clears them); its position on the entity is kept. Free.

entity_id.description: UUID of a tracked world-graph entity in that campaign (chargen_list_entities)

image_id.description: UUID of one of the user's own gallery images (not a video or audio item)

title.description: Optional title shown with the image on the entity

caption.description: Optional caption shown with the image on the entity

tools.name: chargen_create_collection
tools.description: Create a folder in the World Codex (omit campaign_id) or a campaign workspace (campaign_id set). Free accounts can keep up to 3 folders in total across the World Codex and campaign workspaces; paid plans have no folder limit.

tools.name: chargen_create_hook
tools.description: Add a plot hook to a campaign with a title and optional description.

tools.name: chargen_create_quest
tools.description: Create a quest in a campaign's quest tracker with a title and optional category, status, quest giver, objectives, conditions, rewards and next actions.

tools.name: chargen_create_session_log
tools.description: Create a session from a DM-approved prose summary (200 to 20000 characters), free at Standard quality on any paid plan. Obtain approval of the summary, then set confirm=true. Processing creates a recap, entities, timeline, hooks and quest updates in the background, with no transcript or speaker features.

session_number.description: Session number to backfill. Omit to append after the latest session.

recorded_at.description: When the session was played, ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for now.

tools.name: chargen_dedupe_candidates
tools.description: Auto-merge duplicate CANDIDATE entities in a campaign that share the same normalized name and type, keeping the best-evidenced one. Never touches TRACKED or pinned entities - merge those explicitly with chargen_merge_entities. It also returns merge_suggestions: an NPC record and a Monster record with the same name (often one villain who was talked to in one session and fought in the next). These are NOT merged. To merge one, ask the DM which record to keep and call chargen_merge_entities with that record as target_entity_id; the target keeps its type and the merge can be undone. This connector cannot dismiss a suggestion: the DM keeps the two records separate on the web Review page, and until then the pair is listed again.

tools.name: chargen_delete_collection
tools.description: Delete a folder (and its subfolders/filed rows). Only ORGANISATION is deleted - the generations, entities, sessions and images filed inside are never touched. To unlink a codex folder from a campaign workspace without deleting it, pass the grafted root's ref_row_id; deleting the codex original also removes every campaign reference to it. An Atlas place (place=true) is different: its sub-places, folders and filed things move up to its parent place, and a place a campaign links to directly cannot be deleted until that link is removed.

collection_id.description: Collection UUID (a folder id or a grafted root's ref_row_id)

tools.name: chargen_delete_recap_entry

tools.name: chargen_edit_3d_animate
tools.description: Start a job to rig and animate one of the user's 3D models with Tripo Animate (the rig is included): 1 to 5 moves, one named clip each in one file. Price by the number of moves: 1 move 50 Gold, 2 moves 65, 3 moves 75, 4 moves 90, 5 moves 105. First call chargen_quote_3d_animate, confirm the price with the user, then supply its quote_token with identical inputs. Spends the quoted Gold; returns request_id to poll with chargen_get_job, which gives the model file (media_url, model_format) when it is done. An identical call within about 10 minutes returns the earlier request instead of charging again; pass a new idempotency_key when the user wants another take with the same settings.

model_id.description: A 3D model from the user's own gallery: an image_id from chargen_search_gallery with media_type model_3d, or a finished 3D job's image_id.

moves.description: 1 to 5 moves, one clip each (default walk). Each move adds to the price.

rig_type.description: Body type of the skeleton (default auto).

bone_names.description: Bone naming standard, for the engine the model goes to (default tripo).

file_format.description: File type of the result (default glb). Tripo can return FBX even when glb is asked for.

in_place.description: Keep the model in place instead of moving forward (default false).

quote_token.description: Approved quote_token from chargen_quote_3d_animate. Use the same inputs; changed inputs or prices fail without charging.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key (letters, numbers, - and _). Reusing it returns the same request without a new charge; a new key makes a new take with the same settings.

tools.name: chargen_generate_character_sprites
tools.description: Order animated pixel sprites of a character from one of the user's own still pictures (source_image_id from chargen_search_gallery). An order can have up to 10 portrait moves (preset or in the user's own words), the walk in 4 facings (walk_4_facings) or in 8 directions (walk_8_directions), and game moves in the facings the user picks (game_moves, at most 24 facings). It needs at least one move. Price: 10 Gold for each portrait or typed move, 48 Gold for the walk in 4 facings (12 for each facing), 80 Gold for the walk in 8 directions (10 for each facing), and 25 Gold for each facing of a game move. All moves of one picture and style are drawn from one base sprite, so they match. While the first order for a picture and style still draws that base, a new order for it fails and charges nothing; order again when the first is done. These are animated moves; for one still sprite sheet image, use chargen_run_recipe_rpg_sprite_sheet. First call chargen_quote_character_sprites, confirm the price with the user, then supply its quote_token with identical inputs. Returns request_id; poll chargen_get_job for each move's animated GIF. A move that fails is refunded. An identical call within about 10 minutes returns the earlier request instead of charging again; pass a new idempotency_key when the user wants another take with the same settings.

custom_actions.description: Moves in the user's own words, for example "raises a glass in a toast".

details.description: Optional details the picture does not show, for example "a captain's rapier".

walk_8_directions.description: true adds a looping walk in all 8 facings, 80 Gold (10 for each facing). A facing that fails is refunded 10. Give walk_4_facings or walk_8_directions, not both.

walk_4_facings.description: true adds a looping walk in 4 facings, S, E, N and W: 48 Gold (12 for each facing), cut from the same video as the walk in 8 directions. A facing that fails is refunded 12. Give walk_4_facings or walk_8_directions, not both.

game_moves.description: Game moves, each move at most once, 25 Gold for each facing. At most 24 facings in all. A facing that fails is refunded 25. For a walk, walk_4_facings costs less than the walk game move in the same 4 facings.

move.description: The game move. idle, walk, run and sprint loop; the others play one time, and death stops on its last frame.

facings.description: The facings to make this move in, each one at most once. S faces the viewer (down the screen), N faces away (up the screen), E faces right and W faces left; SE, NE, NW and SW are between them.

title.description: Optional name for these sprites in the user's library.

tools.name: chargen_generate_sprite_effect
tools.description: Order an animated pixel sprite effect, for example a fireball or a healing light, from a preset or the user's own description, in parts that play one after another: 10 Gold for the first part and 8 for each more part. It can be drawn in an element's colours, or in the colours of one of the user's character sprite sets (reference_set_id). First call chargen_quote_sprite_effect, confirm the price with the user, then supply its quote_token with identical inputs. Returns request_id; poll chargen_get_job for each part's animated GIF. A part that fails is refunded. An identical call within about 10 minutes returns the earlier request instead of charging again; pass a new idempotency_key when the user wants another take with the same settings.

preset.description: One of CharGen's effects. Give preset or description, not both.

description.description: The effect in the user's own words, in place of preset.

parts.description: The parts to draw, by key, each one at most once. With a preset, its own parts (explosion: SPARK, BLAST, SMOKE; aura: RISES, PULSES, FADES; fireball: FORMING, FLYING, BURST; lightning: GATHERS, STRIKE, SCORCH; frostnova: GATHERS, BURST, LINGERS; slash: CHARGE, SLASH, SMALL_HIT; necrotic: GATHERS, BURST, LINGERS; heal: BURST, RISES, FADES; poison: SPLASH, CLOUD, DRIPS; arcaneorb: ORB, FLYING, BURSTS; shield: RISES, HOLDS, BREAKS; portal: OPENS, SWIRLS, CLOSES). With a description: BUILDS_UP, MAIN, FADES. parts and custom_parts together hold 1 to 10 parts.

custom_parts.description: Parts in the user's own words.

text.description: What the part shows, in the user's own words.

plays.description: LOOP (the default) repeats, ONCE plays one time, HOLD plays and stops on its last frame.

element.description: Optional element or colour that every part is drawn in.

reference_set_id.description: Optional set_id of one of the user's character sprite sets (chargen_get_job shows set_id). The effect is drawn in the colours of that character's Cast move, or of its base sprite.

title.description: Optional name for these sprites in the user's library.

quote_token.description: Approved quote_token from chargen_quote_sprite_effect. Use the same inputs; changed inputs or prices fail without charging.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key (letters, numbers, - and _). Reusing it returns the same request without a new charge; a new key makes a new take with the same settings.

tools.name: chargen_get_job
tools.description: Check a job by id: an entity generation job, or a request from chargen_generate_image, a fixed video, audio, image edit or workflow run tool from chargen_list_recipes, or a Pixel Sprites order tool. Returns status, the error on failure, and when ready the generation id or the media (media_type, media_url, page_url; a workflow run lists every output with its role; a sprite order lists every move or part with its animated GIF, its set_id and any Gold refunded). Checking a job never cancels it and never deletes or overwrites content. When a video, audio, edit or workflow job passes its time limit, CharGen records it as timed out and returns its Gold, whether or not anyone checks. preset.description: One of CharGen's effects. Give preset or description, not both.

Show the complete draft first and call this only after the GM explicitly asks to save it. The draft creates a private NPC library entry and links it to the selected campaign entity for 0 Gold. No portrait or AI generation runs. Retrying the same draft returns its saved ID and the original campaign_entity_id, even if the GM later removed the link. Use chargen_generate_npc to ask CharGen to generate an NPC. Requires a paid CharGen account and the mcp:write scope.

campaign_id.description: UUID of the campaign you own

entity_id.description: UUID of an existing NPC entity in that campaign

name.description: Must match the selected campaign NPC name.

gameType.description: D&D or Savage Worlds (SWADE). For SWADE, put combat mechanics in the swade object.

level.description: Level or power rank when the system uses one.

connections.description: People or entities connected to the NPC.

stats.description: D&D ability scores. Use STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS and CHA (full names are accepted and saved canonically).

hitPoints.description: Hit points or equivalent, when used.

armorClass.description: Armor class, when used. Omit for systems without it.

savingThrows.description: Saving throws, when the system uses them.

spells.description: Spells, when the system uses them.

wildCard.description: Whether this is a Wild Card.

agility.description: SWADE trait die, normalized by the native sanitizer.

smarts.description: SWADE trait die, normalized by the native sanitizer.

spirit.description: SWADE trait die, normalized by the native sanitizer.

strength.description: SWADE trait die, normalized by the native sanitizer.

vigor.description: SWADE trait die, normalized by the native sanitizer.

die.description: SWADE skill die, normalized by the native sanitizer.

edges.description: Edges shown in the SWADE NPC panel.

hindrances.description: Hindrances shown in the SWADE NPC panel.

type.description: Minor or Major; the native sanitizer normalizes this value.

specialAbilities.description: Special abilities shown in the SWADE NPC panel.

gear.description: Gear shown in the SWADE NPC panel.

powers.description: Powers shown in the SWADE NPC panel.

draft.description: Complete NPC draft approved by the GM. Use the selected campaign NPC's name.

tools.name: chargen_search_campaign
tools.description: Text search within one campaign across world-graph entities and aliases, quests, threads, recap NPCs/monsters/locations/items and transcripts. Returns typed hits with excerpts.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's nextCursor

tools.name: chargen_search_gallery
tools.description: Search your gallery of images, videos, audio and 3D models: returns image_id, media_type, URLs, titles and source metadata. Filter with media_type; a 3D model (media_type model_3d) also carries model_url and model_format, and its image_id is the model_id the 3D tools take. Never returns file bytes.

media_type.description: Only return this kind of gallery item.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's nextCursor

limit.description: Max items to return (at most 25, the default); page with nextCursor for more.

tools.name: chargen_track_entity
tools.description: Add a bare tracked entry (name + optional note) to a campaign's world graph - NO AI content is generated. For a full AI-written NPC, monster, quest etc. with stats and a portrait, use a fixed generation tool such as chargen_generate_npc or chargen_generate_monster instead. A matching entry may have its name, pin state or status updated; new description and note text is appended.

entity_type.description: NPC, MONSTER, LOCATION, FACTION or ITEM

tools.name: chargen_undo_entity_merge
tools.description: Reverse one recorded world-graph entity merge in a campaign you own. Pass the merge_id from chargen_merge_entities or chargen_list_entity_merges. Restores the archived source and moves recorded links back. Also reverses session renames recorded with that merge_id; subsequently edited text is skipped and reported in skipped_renames.

tools.name: chargen_update_collection
tools.description: Rename, reorder or move a folder: name/description edit, display_order to reorder among siblings, parent_collection_id to nest under another folder, clear_parent=true to move back to the root. Grafted codex references (ref_row_id rows) can be renamed and reordered but never moved. Supplied name and description values replace the stored values. An Atlas place (place=true) moves only under another place of its own atlas, and an atlas root stays at the top level.

collection_id.description: Collection UUID

display_order.description: New sort position among siblings (lower sorts first)

clear_parent.description: true moves the folder back to the root (mutually exclusive with parent_collection_id)

tools.name: chargen_update_entity
tools.description: Update a world-graph entity: notes, description, status (TRACKED / ARCHIVED) and pin. Manage alias spellings with add_aliases / remove_aliases - aliases teach session processing which names map to this entity.

add_aliases.description: Alias spellings to add - teaches session processing to map these names to this entity in FUTURE sessions (use for recurring mispronunciations)

remove_aliases.description: Existing alias strings to remove (case-insensitive match)

tools.name: chargen_update_generation
tools.description: Edit fields of a GENERATION's output (a saved library item), e.g. fix a name or rewrite a backstory. Pass changes as {field_path: new value} using paths from chargen_get_generation's output (dots and [index] for lists, e.g. "inventory[2].name"). Paths must already exist. Requires a plan above Basic. Concurrent edits in the app can race this tool (last write wins). For campaign-tracked entities use chargen_update_entity instead. Generation library items are public by default, so edits may be visible in public CharGen browsing; visibility can be changed in CharGen.

changes.description: Map of field_path -> new value, e.g. {"personality": "kindly", "quirks[1]": "whistles"}

tools.name: chargen_update_quest
tools.description: Update a quest: status, next actions, rewards, resolution. Provide progress_note to append a progress-log entry.

next_actions.description: What the party should do next

progress_note.description: Append this to the progress log

tools.name: chargen_update_recap
tools.description: Edit a session recap: full / short / spoiler-free summaries and DM notes. Only the fields you pass are changed; the recap is flagged as edited.

tools.name: chargen_update_thread
tools.description: Update a plot thread: set status/severity, add a note, or promote it into a full quest.

note.description: Append this note to the thread

promote.description: Promote this thread into a quest

tools.name: chargen_usage_guide
tools.description: The CharGen playbook, by area. With no topic: the overview (how the tools compose, what is free and what costs gold, job polling, error handling) and the list of area guides. With a topic: that area's guide, such as world building, sessions, or art with how to write prompts for each image, video and audio model. Call this once when you first work with CharGen tools in a conversation, or whenever unsure which tool fits.

topic.description: Which guide to read; leave out for the overview. overview: what CharGen is, what is free and what costs Gold, job polling, errors, and this list. worldbuilding: the content generators, saving and editing library entries, the world graph, folders and workspaces. sessions: reading recaps and transcripts, logging a session nobody recorded, correcting a session's history. art: images, video, audio, 3D and pixel sprites: what costs Gold and how to write any prompt. Start here, then read the medium's guide. art_images: image rendering, image edits, workflows and pixel sprites, and how to write an image prompt for each model family. art_video: video from text, pictures and references, talking portraits and motion transfer, and how to write a video prompt. art_audio: speech, music and sound effects, and what the prompt is for each. art_3d: 3D models and the tools that change them.

tools.name: chargen_whoami
tools.description: Who is connected: account email/display name, balance (gold or USD wallet), tier and unlocked capabilities.
